title: Daniel Márquez — backend & cloud engineer
description: Backend & Cloud Engineer building Go and Python serverless systems on AWS, distributed backends, event-driven workflows and applied AI/RAG.
exp_ff_desc: Building a serverless computation engine on AWS for the renewable energy sector: data modeling, numerical computation with Python and NumPy, performance work, and infrastructure as code with AWS SAM.
exp_op_desc: Production EdTech platform spanning a Go exam backend, Moodle integrations, protected HLS video, recurring payments, document ingestion and applied AI systems with deterministic data boundaries.
exp_sd_desc: Developed and maintained Odoo modules using Python, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, and JasperReports. Built custom business logic, views, and reports to meet client requirements, and optimized PostgreSQL queries to improve performance on data-heavy operations. Introduced a self-hosted CI/CD pipeline with Gitea and containerized the codebase with Docker, shipping it as a single versioned image rather than loose module folders to make builds reproducible and deployments to production reliable.
exp_big_desc: Maintained Moodle mobile apps with Ionic, Android Studio, and Xcode. Deployed and managed Moodle platforms on AWS. Automated routine tasks with Python.
stack_subtitle: Core technologies and the systems they connect.
projects_subtitle: A few production systems and engineering projects.
proj_impronta_desc: Multi-tenant HLS video protection platform for academies, built around isolated AWS infrastructure and controlled playback access.
proj_impronta_highlight_1: Tenant isolation across S3, CloudFront and DynamoDB
proj_impronta_highlight_2: Signed access, HLS delivery and per-user watermarking
proj_impronta_highlight_3: Async processing, usage metering and concurrency controls
proj_oposita_desc: Production EdTech platform combining exam workflows, Moodle, payments, protected video and applied AI without making the data probabilistic.
proj_oposita_highlight_1: Go exam platform with scoring, percentiles and streaming imports
proj_oposita_highlight_2: AWS document ingestion with S3 Vectors, Textract and async jobs
proj_oposita_highlight_3: Idempotent payment ledger and independent Moodle access grants
proj_finance_desc: Event-driven Go pipeline that consolidates broker files without bank credentials or duplicate operations.
proj_finance_highlight_1: S3 events trigger ARM64 Lambda processing
proj_finance_highlight_2: DynamoDB conditional writes make deduplication atomic
proj_finance_highlight_3: Least-privilege IAM, OIDC CI/CD and near-zero cost
proj_ride_desc: Offline-first motorcycle telemetry where lean angle is derived from motion models instead of the obvious gravity shortcut.
proj_ride_highlight_1: Independent lean estimates from GPS speed + yaw rate and fused orientation
proj_ride_highlight_2: Signal filtering, anti-aliasing and mount-shift detection
proj_ride_highlight_3: Pure JVM RideProcessor with raw recordings for offline reprocessing
proj_sizing_desc: Solar and battery-storage sizing engine optimized to fit a numerical workload inside API Gateway's hard timeout.
proj_sizing_highlight_1: Vectorized NumPy computation over hourly simulation data
proj_sizing_highlight_2: Scenario search across PV, BESS and economic constraints
proj_sizing_highlight_3: Performance and cost decisions expressed in serverless infrastructure
